title: Activity Discount on Crestline Companion Fares for Active Summit Members
content:
Holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes who are active flyers in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program receive an activity discount on the companion fare. It follows two records of the holder's Summit membership together, both counted back 12 months from the handling date:

- the qualifying dollars credited by qualifying-dollar accrual entries dated in the last 12 months; and
- the number of Crestline flight accrual entries dated in the same 12 months.

| Qualifying dollars in the last 12 months | Crestline flight accrual entries in the last 12 months | Activity discount |
|---|---|---|
| 15000 USD or more | 12 or more | 12 percent |
| 5000 USD or more, without reaching both 15000 USD and 12 flights | 6 or more | 6 percent |
| any other combination | | none |

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Qualifying dollars | Flights | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 18000 | 14 | 12 percent |
| 18000 | 8 | 6 percent |
| 7000 | 20 | 6 percent |
| 18000 | 5 | none |
| 4000 | 20 | none |
